message: a bound `aria-busy` on the host of PctPending sets the live region of `warning` otherwise than its role does
$reason: A component whose host block binds `[ariaBusy]`, the property that reflects `aria-busy`, its template holding a warning part with its `status`. In the state where the binding is `true` Firefox 158 hands the part below the host `container-busy="true"` (measured on 2026-10-27), and NVDA drops it. A host key is read as the attribute it reaches, a binding of the property as one of `[attr.aria-busy]`; point 7 read none of it.
